scope: All Latin words in authoritative manual verses only; no opening antiphon review, publication or user proofreading certification.
method: Visually read every unpublished verse in the source-excerpts cropped from the supplied PDF, including all continuations and alternatives; checked suspicious underlay at enlarged scale. Rendered the eight changed exact-source verse-only scores and inspected them. Pattern screening was only an additional completeness aid, never the basis for a split.
publicationSafeguard: Read manual.json and review-state.json at inventory and again immediately before every synchronous ReviewStore.save; exact-file source hash required. Final publication inventory still excludes the same ten chants.
